instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium full shot. On a paved park path, the bald man in the olive t-shirt (R2) and the man in the white t-shirt (R1) walk side-by-side. The bald man (R2) on the left smiles warmly at his partner, holding his hand and clasping his arm. The man in the white t-shirt (R1) on the right walks forward, smiling back. Strong afternoon sun shines from behind, creating a bright, prominent lens flare around the bald man's head.
